high_level_description: A wide photograph of a grand old public library reading room in late afternoon, readers at long tables, tall arched windows, warm sunlight falling in long beams through dusty air.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Two-storey reading room with dark walnut bookshelves reaching to a coffered plaster ceiling painted pale green with gilded rosettes, a gallery with a wrought-iron railing running around the upper level, three tall arched windows on the left wall with small leaded panes, beams of warm low sunlight crossing the room diagonally and lighting floating dust, polished parquet floor in a herringbone pattern, cool shadow on the right side of the room.

elements.desc: Three long oak reading tables arranged in parallel rows from the foreground into the depth of the room, each with a row of brass lamps with green glass shades, some lamps switched on.
Elderly man in a tweed jacket and round tortoiseshell glasses at the nearest table, reading a large atlas open flat in front of him, one finger tracing a coastline.
Young woman with a dark bob haircut and a mustard cardigan typing on a silver laptop at the middle table, a stack of library books and a paper coffee cup beside her.
Teenage boy in a grey hoodie with headphones around his neck, asleep with his head resting on his folded arms on an open chemistry textbook.
Librarian with silver hair in a bun and a navy dress pushing a wooden book trolley loaded with returned books along the right aisle.
Rolling wooden ladder attached to a rail on the bookshelves on the right wall, its lower rungs worn pale.
Large antique globe on a carved wooden stand at the end of the first table, lit by a sunbeam.
Grandfather clock with a brass pendulum standing between two bookshelves at the back wall, showing twenty past four.
Small brass plaque mounted on the end of the nearest bookshelf, engraved serif letters, uppercase, regular, upright, tiny.
Gold-painted serif lettering on a dark wooden sign hanging above a doorway at the back of the room, title case, regular, upright, small.
Potted palm in a blue and white porcelain planter next to the arched window, its fronds catching the light.
Pigeon sitting on the outside ledge of the middle window, seen as a silhouette against the bright sky.
Open card catalogue cabinet with small brass-handled drawers in the left foreground, one drawer pulled out with index cards visible.
